paragraphs: Mentioned in [Megillah 4a](https://www.sefaria.org/Megillah.4a.10); in [Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 2:4](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Megillah.2.4.5); in [Moed Katan 26a](https://www.sefaria.org/Moed_Katan.26a.23). Hyman cites the [end of Vayikra Rabbah chapter 11](https://www.sefaria.org/Vayikra_Rabbah.11.9) for the chain in which R. Chelbo speaks in the name of Ulla Biraah, who speaks in the name of R. Elazar. In [Vayikra Rabbah 13:2](https://www.sefaria.org/Vayikra_Rabbah.13.2) he spoke in the name of R. Shimon bar Yochai.[^1]

notes.text: Moed Katan gives precisely the short, three-person chain Hyman quotes. In the Vayikra Rabbah 11 parallel and Jerusalem Megillah, the chain also includes Rabbi Berekhya and ends with Rabbi Chanina. The Vayikra Rabbah 13 passage has Ulla speaking in the name of Rabbi Shimon ben Yochai. Compare [Heilprin’s notice](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2855&lang=en).
